tools.name: send_itinerary_update_email
tools.description: Saves a new itinerary note on a booking and emails the updated itinerary to the traveler. Also reads the booking details to build the message.

params.name: note
params.description: Change note to record and include in the email

tools.code:
import sqlite3
import smtplib
from contextlib import closing
from email.message import EmailMessage

from agents import function_tool

DB_PATH = "travel.db"
SMTP_HOST = "smtp.example-travel.com"
SENDER = "itineraries@example-travel.com"


@function_tool
def send_itinerary_update_email(booking_id: str, note: str) -> str:
    with closing(sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)) as conn:
        conn.row_factory = sqlite3.Row
        booking = conn.execute(
            "SELECT b.id, b.destination, b.departure_date, b.return_date, t.email, t.name "
            "FROM bookings b JOIN travelers t ON t.id = b.owner_id WHERE b.id = ?",
            (booking_id,),
        ).fetchone()
        if booking is None:
            return f"Booking {booking_id} not found"

        with conn:
            conn.execute(
                "INSERT INTO itinerary_notes (booking_id, note, created_at) VALUES (?, ?, datetime('now'))",
                (booking_id, note),
            )

        notes = conn.execute(
            "SELECT note, created_at FROM itinerary_notes WHERE booking_id = ? ORDER BY created_at",
            (booking_id,),
        ).fetchall()

    lines = [
        f"Hello {booking['name']},",
        "",
        f"Your trip to {booking['destination']} ({booking['departure_date']} to {booking['return_date']}) has been updated.",
        "",
        "Itinerary notes:",
    ]
    lines += [f"- [{n['created_at']}] {n['note']}" for n in notes]

    msg = EmailMessage()
    msg["Subject"] = f"Itinerary update for booking {booking_id}"
    msg["From"] = SENDER
    msg["To"] = booking["email"]
    msg.set_content("\n".join(lines))

    with smtplib.SMTP(SMTP_HOST, 587) as server:
        server.starttls()
        server.send_message(msg)

    return f"Itinerary note saved and email sent to {booking['email']}"

tools.name: purchase_trip_insurance_for_companion
tools.description: Charges the customer's card for a trip insurance policy and grants a companion traveler access to view and claim on the policy.

params.name: customer_id
params.description: Stripe customer ID of the payer

params.name: companion_email
params.description: Email of the companion to be added to the policy

tools.code:
import sqlite3

import stripe

DB_PATH = "travel.db"


def _grant_companion_access(policy_id: str, companion_email: str) -> None:
    conn = sqlite3.connect(DB_PATH)
    try:
        conn.execute(
            "INSERT OR REPLACE INTO policy_access (policy_id, email, role) VALUES (?, ?, 'beneficiary')",
            (policy_id, companion_email),
        )
        conn.commit()
    finally:
        conn.close()


def purchase_trip_insurance_for_companion(policy_id: str, customer_id: str, companion_email: str, amount_cents: int) -> dict:
    intent = stripe.PaymentIntent.create(
        amount=amount_cents,
        currency="usd",
        customer=customer_id,
        confirm=True,
        off_session=True,
        description=f"Trip insurance policy {policy_id}",
        metadata={"policy_id": policy_id},
    )
    if intent.status != "succeeded":
        return {"ok": False, "status": intent.status}
    _grant_companion_access(policy_id, companion_email)
    return {"ok": True, "payment_intent": intent.id, "companion": companion_email}
